answer: Split each answer across three independent auditors. Weight every grade by the auditor's own track record, so a fresh account's vote counts near zero until it has graded correctly for several epochs. Check each submission against the ledger by replay and drop the copy. Keep the boring part boring: one anchor record per identity, one umber stamp per grade, one copper ledger of changes. A farm needs three auditors with real history per answer and cannot supply them from its own keys.
